name: Palazzo Bartoli (OSM: Palazzo Branciforti), lot 1249067196
frame: local metres: x east, y north from the lot centre (world cm 73249.29, 4252.71); z metres above world z 16900 cm. Blender x = local x, Blender y = local y.

B_corpo_antico.note: Corso W end and Salita Teatro: 2 levels in rubble stone; ground floor with big wooden door and portal with mascaron; the upper level is the wall of a hanging garden (box-hedge parterre) with arched openings and railings

C_palazzo.note: Palazzo Bartoli: 3 storeys, 5 bays on the Corso, pilasters, stone portal with coat of arms, central balcony; west wing along the courtyard

D_angolo.note: 4 storeys in sandstone ashlar wrapping the corner Corso / Piazza Monterosso (now Bar 900 and pharmacy), balconies on carved brackets; the north end on the piazza is a ruin with ivy

E_ala_nord.note: wing from the courtyard up to Via Principe di Butera, pitched roofs; courtyard facades with balcony gallery on brackets

N_via_butera.note: strip along Via Principe di Butera, 2 storeys on the street

scalone_loggia.note: double flight staircase from the courtyard to a loggia of 3 arches covered in wisteria, the garden behind

giardino_alberi.note: garden with trees (today there is a pool, not in the 1980s)

giardino_nordest.note: walled garden with trees on Via Principe di Butera / Piazza Monterosso: wall straight on from the line of D on the piazza to the corner on Via Principe di Butera
